card.name: Inside rare drug and surname pieces
card.fires_on: Responds to a short middle piece of a rare drug name, such as the 'cl' in Daclatasvir or the 'ac' in Tofacitinib. It also fires on middle pieces of uncommon surnames.

modes.label: Drug name middles
modes.description: A middle piece inside a long drug name, mostly Tofacitinib, Daclatasvir or Guanfacine.
